name: Snake’s Swiftness
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (snake scales)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one ally
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The creature you target with this spell can immediately take one melee or ranged attack at their highest base attack bonus. Taking this action does not affect your ally’s place in the initiative order. Otherwise, this attack follows the normal rules for attacking.

If the creature uses this extra attack, they may not make an extra attack via another casting of this spell, haste, or a similar effect until the beginning of your next turn. If they have already made an extra attack via another casting of this spell, haste, or a similar effect this round, the spell fails.

Snake’s Swiftness, Mass

School necromancy; Level druid 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets allies in a 20 ft. radius burst

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as snake’s swiftness, except as shown above.
